definitions.explanation: A ball of mud shaped by hand, a classic form of children's play. Polished versions known as {光|ひか}る{泥|どろ}{団子|だんご} (shiny mud balls) are made smooth and glossy with care.

examples.japanese: {泥|どろ}{団子|だんご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦{砂場|すなば}→砂場：06326_sunaba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{泥|どろ}{団子|だんご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{丸|まる}めて→丸める：11313_marumeru⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んだ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: We played in the sandbox rolling mud balls.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何時間|なんじかん}→何時間：30372_nanjikan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧、⟦つるつる→つるつる：05175_tsurutsuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{光|ひか}る→光る：01163_hikaru⟧{泥|どろ}{団子|だんご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げた→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧。
examples.english: Spending hours on it, I finished a mud ball polished to a smooth shine.

notes:
A handmade ball of mud, one of the most familiar forms of Japanese children's outdoor play.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {泥|どろ}{団子|だんご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make a mud ball

- ⟦{光|ひか}る→光る：01163_hikaru⟧{泥|どろ}{団子|だんご}: shiny (polished) mud ball
